SELECT "id", "name", "event_space", "capacity", "address", "contactinfo"
FROM "eventspaces"
WHERE LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
  AND "capacity" = 200;

SELECT
    es."id",
    es."name",
    es."event_space",
    es."capacity",
    es."address",
    es."contactinfo"
FROM "eventspaces" es
WHERE es."capacity" = 200
  AND (
        LOWER(es."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
     OR LOWER(es."event_space") LIKE '%conference%'
     OR LOWER(es."name") LIKE '%banquet%'
     OR LOWER(es."name") LIKE '%conference%'
  )
ORDER BY es."name";

SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name,
       lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = LOWER('New York')
  AND LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%swimming%'

UNION


SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name,
       lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = LOWER('New York')
  AND LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%hot tub%'

SELECT DISTINCT
    h."name" AS hotel_name,
    h."address" AS hotel_address,
    c."name" AS city_name,
    lf."feature" AS feature
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = LOWER('New York')
  AND (
      LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%swimming%'
      OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%pool%'
      OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%hot tub%'
  )
ORDER BY h."name", lf."feature";

SELECT DISTINCT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE LOWER(c."name") = LOWER('New York')
  AND (
    LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%swimming pool%'
    OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%pool%'
    OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%hot tub%'
    OR LOWER(lf."feature") LIKE '%jacuzzi%'

SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON g."id" = b."guestid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON b."roomid" = r."roomid"
WHERE LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%guest%'

UNION


SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON g."id" = b."guestid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON b."roomid" = r."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON r."serviceid" = s."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%'
  AND LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air%condition%'

SELECT DISTINCT
    g."fullname" AS guest_name,
    r."typeofroom" AS room_type
FROM "bookings" b
JOIN "guests" g ON g."id" = b."guestid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air-condition%'
  AND (
        LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%guest room%'
     OR LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%'
      )
ORDER BY r."typeofroom", g."fullname";

SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"

JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"

SELECT c."channel_value"
FROM "channels" c
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" crc ON crc."channel_id" = c."channel_id"
GROUP BY c."channel_id", c."channel_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT crc."representative_id") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "customer_service_representatives")

SELECT
    csr."id" AS representative_id,
    csr."full_name" AS representative_name,
    csr."email" AS representative_email,
    ch."channel_value" AS channel
FROM "customer_service_representatives" csr
LEFT JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" csr_ch
    ON csr."id" = csr_ch."representative_id"
LEFT JOIN "channels" ch
    ON csr_ch."channel_id" = ch."channel_id"
ORDER BY csr."id", ch."channel_value";
